videos.title: Why You’re Not Financially Free (Yet)
videos.summary: Are you holding yourself back from starting a business because you think you lack the 'right' skills? This video completely dismantles that fear by showing how even the most complex expertise—from digital marketing to cardiovascular surgery—is actually learned on the fly through free online resources. By adopting the 'Teddy Roosevelt Method' of saying yes first and figuring out how later, you'll unlock a powerful mindset shift that turns any barrier to wealth into a simple, solvable skill issue.

videos.title: Expose your site's actions to AI agents using WebMCP
videos.summary: Tired of AI agents failing to navigate your website because they misinterpret buttons and menus? This quick video introduces WebMCP, a game-changing technology that allows websites to explicitly define their capabilities for AI agents using simple JavaScript or HTML. By shifting from visual navigation to direct schema communication, you can build reliable, agent-friendly web applications that work flawlessly every time.
